drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Please find attached Landlord’s revised draft. We have updated Tenant’s legal name, added the rent schedule and Commencement Date formulation, included a tailored cure/abatement right for material service interruptions and uncured Landlord defaults, and added a permitted-transfer carveout for affiliates, merger/consolidation transactions, and substantially all-asset sales, subject to notice and continuing liability/financial responsibility protections.

On assignment/sublease consent, Landlord can agree to a deemed-consent mechanism, provided the request is complete, clearly marked as triggering deemed consent, and Landlord receives a follow-up notice before consent is deemed given. We also revised unauthorized transfers to be voidable at Landlord’s election rather than automatically void.

Regards,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: PARTIES. This Lease is between Calder Properties, as Landlord, and Harbor Street Retail LLC, as Tenant.
edits.name: Parties

edits.text: 2. RENT. The Tenant shall pay the monthly Base Rent set out below, in advance on the first day of each calendar month during the Term, without notice, demand, deduction, or setoff, except as expressly provided in this Lease. Base Rent shall be: Months 1-12: $[___] per month; Months 13-24: $[___] per month; Months 25-36: $[___] per month; Months 37-48: $[___] per month; and Months 49-60: $[___] per month. If the Commencement Date is not the first day of a calendar month, Base Rent for the partial month shall be prorated on a per diem basis and paid on the Commencement Date.
edits.name: Rent schedule

edits.text: 3. TERM. The lease term is sixty months commencing on [__________], 20[__] (the "Commencement Date") and expiring on the last day of the sixtieth full calendar month thereafter, unless earlier terminated in accordance with this Lease.
edits.name: Term and Commencement Date

edits.text: 4. ASSIGNMENT. The Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublet all or any portion of the Premises without the Landlord's prior written consent, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed. Landlord's consent shall be deemed granted only if: (a) Tenant delivers to Landlord a complete written request containing all information reasonably required to evaluate the proposed transfer, prominently stating in bold capital letters that Landlord's failure to respond may result in deemed consent; (b) Landlord fails to approve or disapprove the request within ten business days after receipt of such complete request; (c) Tenant delivers a second written notice to Landlord after expiration of such ten-business-day period, again prominently stating in bold capital letters that consent will be deemed granted if Landlord does not respond; and (d) Landlord fails to respond within five business days after receipt of the second notice. Any assignment or sublease made without required consent shall be voidable at Landlord's election. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Tenant may, without Landlord's prior consent but upon at least ten days' prior written notice where reasonably practicable, assign this Lease or sublet all or a portion of the Premises to: (i) an entity controlling, controlled by, or under common control with Tenant; (ii) a successor to Tenant by merger, consolidation, or reorganization; or (iii) a purchaser of all or substantially all of Tenant's assets or business operated at the Premises, provided in each case that the transferee assumes Tenant's obligations under this Lease in writing, the transfer is not undertaken as a subterfuge to avoid the consent requirements of this Lease, the permitted use is not changed, and Tenant remains liable under this Lease unless Landlord expressly releases Tenant in writing.
edits.name: Assignment and permitted transfers

edits.text: 2. RENT; NO SETOFF; LIMITED ABATEMENT. The Tenant shall pay the monthly Base Rent set out below, in advance on the first day of each calendar month during the Term, without notice, demand, deduction, or setoff, except as expressly provided in this Lease. Base Rent shall be: Months 1-12: $[___] per month; Months 13-24: $[___] per month; Months 25-36: $[___] per month; Months 37-48: $[___] per month; and Months 49-60: $[___] per month. If the Commencement Date is not the first day of a calendar month, Base Rent for the partial month shall be prorated on a per diem basis and paid on the Commencement Date. Notwithstanding the foregoing no-setoff provision, if, due to Landlord's failure to provide an essential service required under this Lease or Landlord's uncured default under this Lease, all or a material portion of the Premises is rendered unusable for Tenant's ordinary business operations for more than five consecutive business days after Landlord receives written notice from Tenant, then Base Rent shall abate proportionately from the sixth business day until the earlier of restoration of use or the date Tenant reoccupies or resumes use of the affected portion of the Premises; provided that abatement shall not apply to the extent the interruption or inability to use the Premises is caused by Tenant or its agents, employees, contractors, invitees, or licensees, or by casualty or condemnation addressed elsewhere in this Lease.
edits.name: Limited cure/abatement right
